title: Understanding your Boat Health Score
description: Read the 0–100 score and how to raise it.

steps.text: Open Boat Health on the dashboard or boat hub.
See the overall score and the breakdown.
Note the areas pulling the score down.
Complete related tasks to raise it.

tips: The score reflects intervals, overdue tasks, and engine data.
It updates as you log and complete work.
affects: Boat Health Score, reminders, and seasonal readiness.
examples: Seeing your score drop for an overdue task.
Watching it recover after completing work.
